function: Hybrid precoding: CNN with heterogeneous pooling attention predicts the analog precoder F_RF from the channel matrix; digital precoder by least squares (pp. 2-3).
system: Single-user mmWave downlink; 64-antenna ULA BS, 4 RF chains, 4 streams, fully connected; 4-antenna user; 28 GHz; no RIS (pp. 1-4).
method: HD-CNN: dilated convolution, two fully connected layers, heterogeneous pooling attention (average pooling real part, max pooling imaginary part); supervised offline training on alternating-minimization labels, Huber loss (pp. 2-3).
data_channel: Simulated Saleh-Valenzuela channels: 3 paths, complex Gaussian gains, uniform AoA/AoD, half-wavelength spacing; labels from alternating-minimization algorithm; dataset size and split not stated (pp. 3-4).
test_conditions: Tested over SNR from -20 to 20 dB with Nt = 64; 128-antenna case at 20 dB reported as generalization; training conditions not stated (pp. 4-5).
baselines: Non-learned: SVD-based full-digital beamforming [4], MO-AltMin hybrid beamforming [8]; learned: DNN [10], standard CNN [15] (p. 4).
metrics: Spectral efficiency and BER versus SNR; number of parameters, FLOPs and execution time (pp. 4-5).
complexity: Parameters 0.18M, FLOPs 0.44M, execution time 0.00459 s at Nt = 64 (Table II, p. 4); 0.00526 at Nt = 128 (Table III, p. 5).
q1_support: p. 1: "The channel model adopts the Saleh-Valenzuela (SV) channel model"; p. 4: "The channel gain, AoA, and AoD are randomly generated". Not met: a custom textbook SV simulator; no 3GPP, COST 2100 or DeepMIMO model and no measured data.
q2_support: p. 5: "To validate HD-CNN in practical large-scale scenarios with increased antennas, we analyzed algorithm runtime and spectral efficiency at 128 transmit antennas". Not met: the paper never states that a model trained at 64 antennas is applied at 128 (Table I, p. 4, sizes the input as 2x4x64) or how it is trained there.
q3_support: p. 4: "MO-AltMin HBF [8]" (iterative optimization, non-learned), "DNN HBF [10]" and "standard-CNN HBF [15]" (earlier learned methods), also SVD-based full-digital [4]; p. 5: "outperforming standard-CNN, DNN and MO-AltMin by 4.1%, 4.7% and 6.6% respectively" in spectral efficiency.
q4_support: p. 4: "0.00459s processing time is 20%, 44%, and 99.36% lower" than the baselines; Table II (p. 4): HD-CNN 0.18M parameters, 0.44M FLOPs, 0.00459 s execution time.
q5_support: p. 4: "The communication system studied in this letter uses the SV channel model for simulation". Not met: no code or data link or DOI, no public or measured dataset; channels and training labels come from the authors' own simulation.
notes: Title and DOI on p. 1 match. Area 3 (hybrid precoding at the BS). q2 is borderline: Section IV-B-5 on p. 5 is titled Generalization Experiments and uses 128 antennas, but the paper does not state that the 64-antenna model is reused (layer sizes in Table I are fixed to Nt = 64), so it is graded as not stated. q1: the Saleh-Valenzuela model is a textbook model.
